label: strong — all five planted findings, no decoys

cards.title: caller-07 pays 9.5x the median unit price
cards.detail: caller-07 is only the #2 spender, but its cost per request is 9.5x the median across callers. Normalising spend by volume surfaces it; a spend ranking does not.

cards.title: caller-01 is 49% of spend
cards.detail: caller-01 accounts for 49% of total spend. Its unit cost sits at the median, so this is volume, not price.

cards.title: model-epsilon fails every request
cards.detail: model-epsilon returned errors on 100% of its 40 requests. Overall error rate is 1.06%, so this does not show in the aggregate.

cards.title: Errors concentrate in hour 14
cards.detail: Hour 14 carries 68% of all errors on 4.5% of requests.

cards.title: Cache hit rate is bimodal
cards.detail: Callers split into a cluster near 0.05 and one near 0.86, with 0 callers in between. A mean would hide this entirely.
